end.line: Quillon for Thornbury Health Trust’s legal team

vo: Thornbury Health Trust has six lawyers for eight hundred estate and service contracts. Here is that work in Quillon.
Drop the contracts into Vault. Every document is read at once, and consent and change of control clauses come back flagged.
For a clinical claims file, Quillon builds the chronology from the exhibits, and every event is cited to its exhibit.
When a clinician or estates manager emails a question, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the contract clause.
Dana will walk your team through it on Monday the twenty-fourth.
